family.tagline: One Companion Core for a solicitor, a bike shop owner and two teens.
family.story: Esperanza runs her family-law practice from a standing desk. Takumi keeps the bike shop's books in the library nook, two floors above the shop. Anouk games in the long living room, and Yara has a bedroom of her own. One Companion Core stands on the living room console.

home.lede: A white glass pavilion sits on the stone roof of a corner building, above two shops. A long stair climbs from the pavement to the terrace and the front door. Inside, a long living room with a hearth opens onto a library nook and the kitchen.

spots.line: The Core on its console, a hearth, a long sofa and a lounge chair.
A writing desk, two ladder shelves and a lounge chair by the entry.
A standing desk, a ladder shelf and a shell chair.
A breakfast bar with three stools, and the range along the wall.
A bed under a wall hanging, with a rubber plant in the corner.

day.line: Esperanza reads the shop's supplier letter at the standing desk.
Takumi turns the repair tags into invoices.
The exhibits go into one bundle before tomorrow's filing.
Yara checks her Spanish paragraph at the counter.
Anouk starts a session from the sofa.
Anouk ticks off tonight's revision quest.
Yara takes her book club novel out to the terrace.
Takumi writes the shop's spring note.

members.name: Esperanza
members.work: family-law solicitor with her own practice

companion.name: Paprika
companion.job: Drafts first summaries of a client's letters from the folder Esperanza connected.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Esperanza checks every line and signs herself.

profile.bio: Esperanza runs her family-law practice from a standing desk. Her client folders sit in Nextcloud on the Core, and Paprika drafts first summaries that she checks line by line.

members.name: Takumi
members.work: runs the bike shop in the building

companion.name: Matcha
companion.job: Opens a supplier's order form and fills in what Takumi typed.
companion.limits: One form at a time. Takumi reads each field and sends it himself.

profile.bio: Takumi runs the bike shop in the building and keeps its books at the writing desk in the library nook. Matcha fills in the supplier's order form, and he sends it himself.
Anouk plays from the sofa in the long living room, on a laptop in her lap. She turns her revision into quests and builds her playlists from the family's music files.
Yara has the bedroom at the end of the hall. She checks her Spanish, saves her sources and reads her book club novel with tools that each do one job on the Core.

popup.title: A parcel below the long stair
popup.body: The courier leaves a parcel at the foot of the long stair. Takumi carries it up to the terrace and through the front door.

popup.title: What the parcel holds
popup.body: Anouk slits the tape. Yara lifts out the Companion Core, a power cable, a quick-start guide and a recovery USB drive.

popup.title: Plugged in on the console
popup.body: Esperanza plugs the cable in beside the shelf. The Core wakes and opens its own Wi-Fi network.

popup.title: Takumi joins from his phone
popup.body: Takumi joins the Core's own network from his phone, then picks the family's home network.

popup.title: Esperanza and Takumi pick agents
popup.body: In the Companion Hub store, Esperanza picks Hermes and Takumi picks OpenClaw. Companion Memory comes along, with Nextcloud, Docuseal and BookStack. Then they walk away.

beats.capability: an agent that connects to chat apps, email and more from one self-hosted app

popup.title: Paprika says hello
popup.body: Esperanza messages the agent she named Paprika. The reply comes from the Core, along the hall from her standing desk.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: esperanza
say.text: Hello, Esperanza. This is Paprika. Where shall we begin?

detail.before: Without an agent, Esperanza typed each reminder and reply into a different app herself.
detail.after: Paprika runs in a sandbox on the Core and replies through the messaging app Esperanza picked. Those messages travel through that chat service.
steps: Pick Hermes in the Companion Hub store
Give the agent a name
Send it a first message
detail.fact: Hermes is an agent built for messaging: it connects to chat apps, email and more from one self-hosted app.

beats.capability: a dashboard of links to your apps

popup.title: One start page for the flat
popup.body: Every phone in the flat has the same bookmark. It opens one page of links to the apps on the Core, so nobody has to remember an address.

detail.before: Each phone kept its own bookmarks, and the Core's address lived on a card in the hall.
detail.after: Heimdall shows one page of links to the apps on the Core. The same bookmark opens it on any phone in the flat.
steps: Add the bookmark to each phone
Open the page of links
Pick the app that is needed
detail.fact: Heimdall is a dashboard of links to your apps.

beats.capability: write a wiki or a set of manuals in books, chapters and pages

popup.title: The building's manual, in one book
popup.body: The bin store key, the boiler service and the plumber's number sit in one BookStack book. Whoever is home opens it by the shelf.

detail.before: The building's practical facts were scattered across sticky notes and one old Confluence page nobody updated.
detail.after: BookStack keeps them as one book with a chapter for the flat and a chapter for the shop. The Core serves it to every phone at home.
steps: Add a chapter for the bin store and the boiler
Write the numbers on a page
Open the book from any phone
detail.fact: BookStack writes a wiki or a set of manuals in books, chapters and pages, with search and history.

beats.capability: stream your own music from your Core to a browser or an app

popup.title: Headphones on by the hearth
popup.body: Anouk builds a playlist from the family's music files in mStream, served by the Core. She plays it to her headphones.

detail.before: Anouk's playlists lived in Apple Music, next to everything else she streamed.
detail.after: mStream streams the music files on the Core to a browser or an app. Her playlists sit beside the files they play.
steps: Open mStream in a browser
Pick songs from the family's music folder
Press play on the headphones
detail.fact: mStream streams your own music from your Core to a browser or an app.

beats.capability: run Steam on your Core and play it in a browser on a screen in the house

popup.title: The match starts on the sofa
popup.body: Anouk's game runs on the Core, and her laptop shows it in a browser tab. She signs in with her own Valve account.
popup.note: Steam needs a Valve account. A Core may lack the graphics power a game wants.

detail.before: Steam lived on the laptop on Anouk's knees, and so did every download.
detail.after: Steam Headless runs her Steam session on the Core. The laptop only opens it in a browser tab, and Valve still keeps the account and the library.
steps: Sign in with her own Valve account
Open the session in a browser tab
Pick a game from her library
detail.fact: Steam Headless runs Steam on your Core and plays it in a browser on a screen in the house.

beats.capability: send newsletters and email campaigns from your own Core

popup.title: The spring service note goes out
popup.body: Takumi writes the shop's spring note in Keila, and the customer list sits on the Core. Sending still goes through an outside mail provider.
popup.note: Delivery depends on the mail provider.

detail.before: The shop's customer list lived in Mailchimp, together with the draft of every note.
detail.after: Keila holds the list and the drafts on the Core. An outside mail provider sends each note.
steps: Write the spring note in Keila
Check the customer list
Send it through the mail provider
detail.fact: Keila sends newsletters and email campaigns from your own Core.

beats.capability: track the pantry, shopping lists, recipes, chores and household habits

popup.title: The pantry list at the fridge
popup.body: When the last tin comes out of the pantry, whoever takes it adds it to the Grocy list. The shopping run starts from that list.

detail.before: The shopping list lived in OurGroceries on one phone, and the pantry was checked by looking.
detail.after: Grocy tracks the pantry and the shopping list together on the Core. Whoever empties a shelf adds the item before they forget.
steps: Log the tin when it comes out
Check the list before the shopping run
Tick items off as they go in the basket
detail.fact: Grocy tracks pantry stock, shopping lists, recipes, chores and household habits.

beats.capability: a spreadsheet-database stored as a SQLite file you can copy

popup.title: Friday's count decides the order
popup.body: On Friday Takumi counts the shop's inner tubes and brake pads beside the range. He types the stock into a Grist table before Saturday's order.

detail.before: The shop's stock count sat in an Airtable base, apart from the order list.
detail.after: Grist keeps the stock in a table stored as a SQLite file on the Core. Takumi's counts and the order sit side by side.
steps: Count the tubes, chains and pads
Type the counts into the stock table
Write the order from what is low
detail.fact: Grist is a spreadsheet-database with real Python formulas, stored as a SQLite file you can copy.

beats.capability: translate text and documents on your own Core

popup.title: Homework checked on the Core
popup.body: At the breakfast bar Yara writes her Spanish paragraph by hand, then checks it in LibreTranslate on the Core. She fixes the two lines that say something else.

detail.before: Yara pasted her homework into DeepL to see whether it said what she meant.
detail.after: LibreTranslate translates text on the Core. Yara writes the Spanish herself and reads the English back to check it.
steps: Write the paragraph by hand
Paste it into LibreTranslate
Fix the lines that read differently
detail.fact: LibreTranslate translates text and documents on your own Core.

beats.capability: keeps your digital life on your own disk and gives your agents individual context

popup.title: Paprika drafts, Esperanza checks
popup.body: At the counter, Paprika drafts a first summary of a client's letters from the folder Esperanza connected in Companion Memory. She checks it line by line against the letters.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

detail.before: A first summary of a long letter file meant reading every page twice before drafting a line.
detail.after: Paprika drafts the summary on the Core from the folder Esperanza connected. She checks every line against the letters before it goes anywhere.
steps: Connect the client folder to Companion Memory
Ask Paprika for a first summary
Check each line against the letters
detail.fact: Companion Memory keeps your digital life on your disk, so your agents know your context.

beats.capability: create and share invoices with client links

popup.title: Repair invoices, printed at the desk
popup.body: Takumi turns the day's repair tags into invoices in Invio. He prints each one to hand over at the shop counter.
popup.note: Client links only work for people who can reach the Core.

detail.before: Repair invoices were built in FreshBooks, and each bike's history lived in a separate notebook.
detail.after: Invio keeps the invoices on the Core. Takumi prints each one for the customer at the counter.
steps: Open the day's repair tags
Raise one invoice for each bike
Print it for the customer
detail.fact: Invio creates and shares invoices, with client links for people who can reach your Core.

beats.capability: lightweight checklists and notes with Kanban boards

popup.title: The board copies the job tags
popup.body: Every bike in the shop wears a job tag, and the board in Jotty copies it. When a customer calls, Takumi reads the board from the nook.

detail.before: The repair jobs sat on a Trello board, and the paper tags on the hooks were the only other copy.
detail.after: Jotty keeps the three columns of the board on the Core. The tag on the bike is still the truth, and the board is the copy.
steps: Write the job on the tag
Hang the tag by the bike
Move the card to the next column
detail.fact: Jotty keeps lightweight checklists and notes, with Kanban boards and sharing.

beats.capability: archive the receipts, warranties and contracts you rarely look at

popup.title: A frame card found in Papra
popup.body: A customer calls about a frame's warranty card. Takumi finds the scan in Papra, filed beside the receipt.

detail.before: Warranty cards went into a shoebox, and the scans of them sat in Evernote under no heading anyone remembered.
detail.after: Papra archives each card with its receipt on the Core, so the right one turns up while the customer is still on the line.
steps: Scan the card when the bike is sold
File it beside the receipt in Papra
Find it when the customer calls
detail.fact: Papra archives the receipts, warranties and contracts you rarely look at, until you need them.

beats.capability: an agent with browser automation and tool use, running in a sandboxed app on your Core

popup.title: Matcha fills in the supplier order
popup.body: Matcha opens the supplier's order form and fills in the inner tubes Takumi typed. Takumi checks every field, then sends it himself.
popup.note: OpenClaw reaches websites over your home internet.

say.speaker: takumi
say.text: The order form is filled in. Please check the quantities before you send it.

detail.before: Restocking meant typing the same shop details into a supplier's form, field by field, every month.
detail.after: Matcha opens the supplier's page in its browser and fills in the form from what Takumi typed. He reads every field and sends it himself.
steps: Type what the shop needs
Let Matcha fill in the form
Read every field, then send it
detail.fact: OpenClaw is an agent with browser automation and tool use, running in a sandboxed app on your Core.

beats.capability: turn habits and chores into a game with levels and quests

popup.title: Revision turns into quests
popup.body: Anouk sets her mock-exam topics as quests in Habitica and ticks them off from her bed. Each finished topic earns a level.

detail.before: Anouk logged her revision habits in Habitify.
detail.after: Habitica turns each topic into a quest on the Core. Finishing the work gives her levels.
steps: Add a quest for each mock-exam topic
Tick the topic off when it is done
Check the level on Sunday
detail.fact: Habitica turns habits and chores into a game with levels and quests.

beats.capability: track every subscription you pay for and get a reminder before it renews

popup.title: Reminders before each renewal
popup.body: Anouk lists her game and music subscriptions in Wallos. A reminder arrives before each renewal, and she decides whether to keep it.

detail.before: Rocket Money listed Anouk's subscriptions, and each renewal still came as a surprise.
detail.after: Wallos lists every subscription Anouk pays for on the Core and reminds her before each one renews.
steps: Add each subscription and its date
Read the reminder before the date
Decide whether to keep it
detail.fact: Wallos tracks every subscription you pay for and sends a reminder before it renews.

beats.capability: fill and sign PDF forms on any device, from your own Core

popup.title: The supplier letter gets signed
popup.body: Esperanza reads the shop's supplier letter at the standing desk. Takumi signs it on her tablet in Docuseal, and the signed PDF stays on the Core.
popup.note: Signers outside the home network need to reach the Core.

detail.before: Agreements were signed through DocuSign, and the finished copy was kept there.
detail.after: Docuseal fills in the PDF on the Core. Takumi signs on her tablet, and the signed copy stays on the Core.
steps: Open the PDF in Docuseal
Fill in the fields
Sign on the tablet
detail.fact: Docuseal fills in and signs PDF forms on any device, from your own Core.

beats.capability: merge, split, compress and convert PDFs on your own Core

popup.title: The exhibits go in her order
popup.body: The evening before a filing, Esperanza lays the paper index on the standing desk. She merges the exhibit PDFs in Stirling-PDF in the order she set.

detail.before: Loose exhibit PDFs went through Smallpdf to become one bundle, in whatever order they were uploaded.
detail.after: Stirling-PDF merges the exhibits on the Core, in the order of the paper index laid beside the keyboard.
steps: Lay the paper index on the desk
Add each PDF in the index order
Merge them into one bundle
detail.fact: Stirling-PDF merges, splits, compresses and converts PDFs on your own Core.

beats.capability: keep your files, calendar and contacts on your own Core, synced to your devices

popup.title: One Nextcloud, two folders
popup.body: The practice keeps its client folders in Nextcloud on the Core, and the shop keeps its papers in another folder. Esperanza opens hers beside the ladder shelf.

detail.before: The practice's client folders sat in Dropbox, and the shop's papers shared the same sign-in.
detail.after: Nextcloud keeps the client folders on the Core, and the shop's papers sit in a folder of their own.
steps: Create a folder for each client
Keep the shop's papers in their own folder
Open a client's folder beside the shelf
detail.fact: Nextcloud keeps your files, calendar and contacts on your own Core, synced to your devices.

beats.capability: save web pages with a screenshot and PDF so they survive link rot

popup.title: Sources for the history essay
popup.body: Yara saves the pages for her history essay in Linkwarden, each with a copy of the page. If a link disappears, her sources are still there.

detail.before: Yara bookmarked her sources in Raindrop.io, and a page that vanished left only a dead link.
detail.after: Linkwarden saves each page with a screenshot and a PDF on the Core, so the source stays readable after the link dies.
steps: Save each source page in Linkwarden
Check the copy has the part she quotes
Cite it from the saved copy
detail.fact: Linkwarden saves web pages with a screenshot and PDF so they survive link rot.

beats.capability: edit documents, spreadsheets and presentations together in the browser

popup.title: Two laptops, one set of slides
popup.body: Yara and Anouk open the same slides in Collabora Online from two laptops. Each edit shows in the other's tab as it happens.

detail.before: The class talk's slides were built in Google Workspace and passed back and forth by message.
detail.after: Collabora Online opens one file from the Core in both browsers. Yara and Anouk edit the same slides together.
steps: Open the slides from the Core
Split the talk between the two laptops
Read it through before Monday
detail.fact: Collabora Online edits documents, spreadsheets and presentations together in the browser.

beats.capability: manage and read books, comics and PDFs with automatic covers and metadata

popup.title: Book club out on the terrace
popup.body: Yara's book club picks a novel as an ebook. She keeps it in BookLore on the Core and reads it on the terrace.
popup.note: BookLore fetches covers and details from outside.

detail.before: Yara's book club reads were bought in Apple Books, and the library stayed inside that one app.
detail.after: BookLore keeps the ebook in a library on the Core and opens it in a browser, so Yara reads wherever the home Wi-Fi reaches.
steps: Add the ebook to the family library
Open it in a browser on her laptop
Read it out on the terrace
detail.fact: BookLore manages and reads books, comics and PDFs, with automatic covers and metadata.

popup.title: A shop, a practice, one Core
popup.body: A standing desk, a writing desk, a long sofa and a bedroom of her own. One glass roof, one Companion Core.

closing.body: A practice, a shop and two sets of homework can live on one Companion Core. Browse the Companion Hub store and pick your first apps.

notes: Told in the v3 shape: 17 of 21 room beats are pair beats naming a registry service; the four pair-less ones are the Heimdall start page, Anouk's Steam Headless session, Paprika's Companion Memory draft and Matcha's order form.

Steam Headless is pair-less on purpose: geforce-now|steam-headless is on the content/story/lander.json hold list, and no cloud gaming service is named. The persona-replaces warning on living-game is that choice.
The home has no TV: Anouk plays in a browser tab on a laptop from the sofa, which is also the media beat at the couch the validator asks for.
Age rule 16: Anouk (sixteen) and Yara (fourteen) use no chat model or agent; Paprika and Matcha work only for Esperanza and Takumi, who approve every result.
Honest edges carried: Steam needs a Valve account; Keila sends through an outside mail provider; Invio client links reach only people who can reach the Core; BookLore fetches covers from outside.

Camera, for the geometry stream: room-quests is a cut (no walkable leg on l3): the gallery, office and bedrooms are closed bays the camera cannot reach from the open plan. The terrace (entry above ground) and the outro are the other cuts.

Small rooms have one standing place each, so the bedroom and office beats carry no from or side hint. The terrace beat is told from the roof terrace loungers (patio-seat), because no deck of this home can be framed.

Apps chosen clear of the fleet cap: no immich, hortusfox, paperless, open-webui, yuvomi, home-assistant or jellyfin. LibreTranslate reaches fourteen of thirty-six families with the plan's rademaker, which is the cap.
